## Population measured — the exposure is **81% of the directory**, and my own dispatch rule introduced a THIRD spelling

Follow-up by the filing seat, 2026-09-12T01:30Z, on `origin/main` @ `9bd4344e4b`. ⚠️ This corrects the scale I implied when I filed this card.

### The census

```
git ls-tree --name-only origin/main .changeset/ | grep '\.md$' | grep -v README     → 209 changesets
```

| shape | count | example |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `<card>-<slug>.md` — card-scoped, the **prevailing** scoped form | **39** | `15052-search-fields-docblock-icontains.md` |
| `issue-<card>-<slug>.md` | **0** | — (⚠️ see below) |
| no card number at all — descriptive or generated | **170** | `analytics-compareto-kind-refusal.md`, `adr-0112-envelope-refusal-declaration.md` |

⇒ ⭐ **170 of 209 (81%) carry no issue scope whatsoever.** When I filed this card I framed the hazard as 「随机 changeset 文件名并行碰撞」 — a *random two-word default*. That understates it: the collision surface is not the occasional generated name, it is **the majority of the directory**, including hand-written descriptive names, which collide exactly as readily when two agents pick the same topic word.

### ⚠️ And I introduced a second scoped spelling today

My dispatches this round mandated ``.changeset/issue-<n>-<slug>.md``. Measured just now: **zero** pre-existing entries use that form, while **39** use the bare ``<n>-<slug>`` form. ⇒ the mandate was followed as written by every round that received it (PR #17740's own report flagged the divergence, correctly, as 「not any of the three filing classes」), but it means the tree now grows **two** scoped conventions instead of converging on one.

⛔ Not a defect — both are collision-free and both are issue-scoped, which is the property this card is about. ⭐ But the fix, when someone writes it, should adopt the **prevailing** ``<n>-<slug>`` spelling, ⛔ not mine. I will use that spelling in subsequent dispatch orders.

### What no gate does

```
grep -n 'isChangesetFile' scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs
  → const isChangesetFile = (p) => p.startsWith('.changeset/') && p.endsWith('.md') && !p.endsWith('/README.md')
```

⇒ the only filename predicate in the changeset gates is **prefix + extension**. Neither `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` nor `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` reads the name for scope, so ⛔ nothing today can notice two agents writing the same filename — which is exactly how the original collision passed with both PRs green.

⚠️ **Declared limit**: I measured the filename population and the filename predicates. ⛔ I did **not** measure how many of the 170 unscoped names were generated by `changeset add` versus hand-written, and that distinction may matter to whoever picks a fix.

## Ruling recorded — A′ + B: a gate refuses a PR that MODIFIES a `.changeset/*.md` that exists on the base and is not the PR's own; new changesets are named issue-scoped by rule, with no gate on names (director seat, decision batch #130 item 3, 2026-09-13)

Maintainer, verbatim (live PM chat, reply received 2026-09-13T07:1xZ), to decision batch #130 presented as `9308 B · 1A′ · 2A′ · 3(A′+B)`: 「同意」.

Derived first from the long-term axis: changesets' random word-pair names were designed for one human running the CLI at a time; this repository runs many agents in parallel drawing from the same small name space, and the collision happened on the first round that used a random name. The durable protection is mechanical and content-blind — "you may not change someone else's release note" — which is exactly the `M`-not-`A` signal that caught this one; the naming rule makes new collisions impossible by construction without touching the 171 legacy files. B alone is the class of protection that just failed, so A′ is not optional. ②③④ do not overturn ①.

### What is ruled
1. **A′ — gate** (`scripts/`, wired into the changeset gate family): a PR whose diff MODIFIES or DELETES a `.changeset/*.md` that exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR is refused by name, with the remedy "rename yours; restore theirs from base". Definition of "added by this PR" is the file's absence on the merge base — re-evaluated against the current base in the merge queue, so a base move cannot make a PR's own file read as foreign. A PR editing its own changeset across commits is unaffected. Self-test covers: foreign `M` (red), foreign `D` (red), own `M` (green), new `A` (green).
2. **B — rule**: new changesets are named `<issue>-<slug>.md`; one line in the dev-round guidance (governed), carried by the skills PR objectstack#17748 is already assembling, ⛔ not its own card and ⛔ not a gate.
3. Legacy names are untouched; the gate looks at diff shape only.

### State
`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `bug` / `domain:devx` / `priority:p2` kept (the gate is the landing point); the B line is noted on #17748.

## 决策落卡 —— 本卡 open_questions 的归宿(H52 收口)

<sub>`domain:devx` 执行席 `session_017ef78bLdybu3AffehKkhfk` 接手自 `session_012GKcPZbMoGq7WPzKLfRBTU` · 读数 2026-09-14T07:26Z</sub>

本卡 dev 报告的 `open_questions` 非空却无 `needs-user-decision` 标签 —— 正是巡查锚 #9857 的 **H52** 形状(已立却谁也够不着)。前席交班附录 `5659988130` 点名要求接手席给它一个归宿。本评论即是,并同笔挂上 `needs-user-decision`。

⚠️ **本席本想另立一张 [Decision] 卡承接**(PR #18146 带 `Closes #17712`,本卡一关问题就随之消失)。**建卡通道在本会话被权限分类器拒绝**(REST `POST /issues`;MCP 内容写入由 lock 1 禁用),⇒ 只能锚在本卡。该限制已一并上报维护者。

## The question, verbatim from the dev report on #17712

> The ruling names no escape hatch for DELIBERATELY correcting somebody else's release note that is already on main (a wrong bump, a wrong package). The gate is content-blind by design, so it refuses that too. Today the report tells such an author to say so on the PR and get it confirmed. Is a mechanical route wanted?

The dev recommended **A**, on the grounds that the case is "rare enough that a human confirmation costs almost nothing".

## What this seat measured — both premises of that recommendation are wrong

Window: 30 days of `origin/main`, `--first-parent`, provably complete (`scripts/pm/git-history.mjs log --days=30 --path=.changeset` → exit 0; floor 2026-08-08, tip 2026-09-14). Population **429** changeset-touching commits; control `--diff-filter=A` = **431** added files. Each candidate was replayed through PR #18146's **actual** gate in a detached worktree at the historical commit (`--base <commit>^`).

| population | n | verdict under the new gate |
|:--|--:|:--|
| non-Version-Packages commits with a foreign `M`/`D` on `.changeset/*.md` | 9 | **exit 1 — all nine** |
| …of those, carried `skip-changeset` (whole job is exempt) | 4 | exempt in practice |
| …of those, added their own changeset ⇒ **cannot** take the exemption | **5** | **hard red** |
| control: changeset-adding commits with no foreign row | 3 | exit 0 — control fires |

**Premise 1 — "there is no mechanical escape" — is false.** The `changeset-check` job is exempt whenever `skip-changeset` is present, and all **4** pure-correction PRs in the window carried it. The escape option B asks for already exists, one notch broader.

**Premise 2 — "the case is rare" — is false for the class that matters.** The **5** that cannot take the exemption (#18011 · #17845 · #17709 · #16750 · #16636) are not the pure-correction shape at all. They are PRs that change behaviour a *pending* release note describes and correct that note in the same stroke.

### The load-bearing case

`ed7243d52` lands boolean support for `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` and rewrites a sibling's pending `.changeset/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.md`, which had stated booleans were refused.

⚠️ Under the new gate that PR is refused, and the remedy it prints — **"rename yours; restore theirs from base"** — instructs the author to restore a release note the same PR has just made **false**. Followed literally, the gate ships an incorrect release note.

⛔ Honesty boundary: this seat measured that these 5 would be refused and read 2 of the 5 diffs. It did **not** adjudicate all five as legitimate. The claim is about the remedy's fit, not a clean bill of health for each edit.

## Options

- **A — as ruled.** No mechanical escape. Correcting a release note is a release decision and goes through a human. ⚠️ Now known to red ~5 PRs / 30d with a remedy that misnames their repair.
- **B — a dedicated exemption label** (`edits-foreign-changeset`) exempting this axis only. ⚠️ Re-opens the prose-protection class the ruling chose A′ over, and largely duplicates `skip-changeset`.
- **C — allow when the diff touches only `.changeset/*.md`.** ⚠️ Weakest: the collision this gate exists to catch is also changeset-only once the colliding author deletes their own file. It also does not cover the 5 measured cases, which are by construction mixed diffs.
- **D — keep A's strength; repair the remedy.** ⭐ *This seat's recommendation.* No new label, no new accept set, no weakening. The refusal keeps firing on every foreign `M`/`D`, but its text names the measured second class ("your change may have made this pending note false") and routes it to the confirmation path that already exists, instead of prescribing "restore theirs from base", which is wrong for that class.

## 四棱

- **实际业务需求** — 实测有拉动,但不在提问设的那一类上。纯更正别人 release note 的 4 张已被 `skip-changeset` 覆盖;真正撞墙的是 5 张「改了行为、顺手改掉描述该行为的待发布说明」。⇒ 需要的不是新出口,是正确的修法指引。
- **项目长远合理性** — 门禁方向正确,contract-first,应当保留。诊断命名了错误的原因是本仓明确记录过的缺陷类;D 修的正是这一条,且不新增任何治理面。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** — 最强的一轴,且指向 D。响亮拒绝优于沉默,所以 ⛔ 不选 C。但一条错的补救语对 AI 比对人更危险:AI 会照做 —— 照 "restore theirs from base" 执行,就会把一条已被本 PR 改成假的发布说明恢复回去,并且全程绿。B 给 AI 一个可自贴的豁免标签,正是「宽容掩盖批量犯错」的温床。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — B 与 C 都是能力面扩张,零拉动(纯更正那类已有 `skip-changeset`),按 implementation-first 从紧处置。D 不扩面:改的是一段散文,不是接受集。

四棱同向 **D**。⛔ 但 A/B/C/D 之间取舍触及门禁强度,属人工地板,本执行席 ⛔ 不代裁。

## 维护者速读

**改了什么** —— 还没改。PR #18146 已按你的裁决把门禁做好了:一个 PR 不许改动或删除别人的发布说明(changeset)。本卡只问它拒绝时**说的那句话**对不对。

**为什么问** —— 本席拿最近 30 天的真实历史跑了一遍这个新门禁:会被拦下的有 9 个 PR,其中 4 个本来就有豁免标签、不受影响;剩下 5 个会被硬拦。这 5 个不是「偷偷覆盖别人」,而是「我改了行为,就顺手把那条还没发布、描述这个行为的说明改对」。门禁给他们的修法是「把别人的那份还原回去」—— 照做就会把一条已经**变成假的**发布说明恢复进发布里。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 现状风险:大约每月 5 个 PR 被一句错误的指引引导,可能发出不正确的发布说明;AI agent 比人更会照字面执行。选 D 的代价极小:只改门禁里的一段提示文字,不碰任何判定逻辑,一次 revert 即可回退。选 B/C 会真正削弱门禁。

**席位意见** —— 建议 **D**:门禁强度一分不减,只把拒绝时那句话改对。B、C 都在放宽,四棱一致不推荐;A 是现状,但已知会误导。

**你要做的** —— 回一个字母:**A / B / C / D**?
